messages:
incidentbot: PagerDuty page fired PD-2419: embedder-eu service > 5xx spike (rate = 18%) severity: high. Links: https://pagerduty.company/PD-2419 :rotating_light:
ashley: saw it, anyone oncall for eu embedder? customer reports multiple 502s. :eyes:
pagerbot: PagerDuty note: ack by kevin at 1754444451 (auto-ack).
kevin: claiming — I'm on it, digging into logs now.
tom: wait i'm current oncall for eng-oncall rotation, i just got the page too. if kevin already acked do you want to hand off or should i take lead?
ashley: we had a recent race where dual acks left the ownership field null. tom, can you confirm which PD responder is listed as owner in the PD UI?
tom: PD UI shows kevin acknowledged, but pager routing still sent me notifications. i'm happy to take ownership if kevin is busy. kevin?
kevin: i started quick triage — looks like embedder instances throwing repeated backend errors after an autoscaler scale-up. i can hand to tom if he's on it.
ashley: tom takes lead. kevin, paste anything useful and then step back.
ton: taking ownership now. running quick checks.

tom: run: ```kubectl get pods -n inference | egrep "embedder|embedder-autoscaler"```
--- output ---
embedder-0   CrashLoopBackOff   1/1   0     2m
embedder-1   Running            1/1   0     6m
embedder-2   Running            1/1   0     6m
embedder-autoscaler-5   1/1   Running   0  4m
```

tom: logs from embedder-0: ```2026-03-17T13:01:22Z ERROR gpu_allocator.cpp:142 OutOfMemory: failed reserve 1.5GB
Stack: ...
Caused 502 upstream response```

kevin: hmm OOM on the new replica after scale-up. autoscaler might have started a pod on a smaller instance type in eu-west-1. I'm checking placement.

liz: customer impact: Support ticket #7891 shows ~120 requests failed across 3 tenants over 6m; appears intermittent. tagging CSMs.

ashley: good. mitigation options: (1) roll back autoscaler to previous target, (2) cordon/evict the failing node, (3) temporarily route traffic to dedicated pool in us-east. tom, which is quickest?

tom: quickest is to drain that pod and restart a stable replica, then scale down the autoscaler target. i'll do (1) + (2) now.

kevin: while tom restarts, i'll patch the HPA to cap replicas to avoid bad placements: ```kubectl patch hpa embedder -p '{"spec":{"maxReplicas":3}}'```

tom: executed: ```kubectl drain node/eu-small-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data``` restarting embedder pods.```

tom: restart logs show embedder-0 restarted and recovered: ```INFO model_loader.cpp: loaded 7.9GB model shards
INFO healthcheck: OK```

liz: monitoring: 5xx rate dropped from 18% -> 1.2% over last 90s. customer ticket updated with mitigation note.

ashley: running postmortem checklist: record timeline, why autoscaler spun up a pod on undersized node, investigate cluster scheduler constraints. kevin opened a follow-up to add nodeSelector/affinity for GPU-backed pods.

kevin: filed ticket INF-5123 with proposed node affinity + HPA guardrails.

tom: paging status: PD-2419 will be marked resolved after 15m stable. I'm staying on call for the next 30m to watch.

liz: PSA to customers sent for affected tenants.

ashley: thanks team. kevin/liz/tom — add notes to the incident runbook and link INF-5123. closing the PD page in 15m if no regression. :white_check_mark:

pagerbot: PagerDuty update: PD-2419 resolved by tom at 1754444485.

incidentbot: Incident thread closed (brief). Remember to add follow-up items to the oncall retro.
